headline: Nifty dips while *broader indices gain*
subline: Mixed session with Nifty 50 down and midcaps up.
hero_text: Institutional flows split with DIIs buying Rs 11,271.73 Cr and FIIs selling Rs 10,148.41 Cr.

why.title: Unclear Triggers
why.desc: No clear catalyst for moves today.

bonus_text: Market breadth was negative with more declines than advances.
movers_note_gainers: ICICI Bank and Kotak Bank led gains on institutional buying.
movers_note_losers: Apollo Hospitals and Max Healthcare weighed down the index.
watch_text: Tomorrow's focus is on economic data including ISM Manufacturing PMI.
lessons: Nifty 50 declined for the third straight session, reflecting ongoing pressure.
Broader indices like the Nifty Midcap 150 showed resilience amidst frontline declines.
Volatility stayed elevated as the India VIX rose over the past week.
Institutional flows showed a split, with DIIs supporting the market against FII selling.
alert_text: Key economic data, including ISM Manufacturing PMI, is due tomorrow.
cta_sub: Daily wrap every evening. Next bell is Thursday.
next_text: Watch for Thursday's session with key economic data releases.
caption_a:
Nifty dipped 0.42% amid mixed flows. Broader indices like Midcap 150 showed strength.
Volatility rose with India VIX up 0.58%.
DIIs net bought Rs 11,271.73 Cr while FIIs net sold Rs 10,148.41 Cr.
